name: MEEMIC INSURANCE COMPANY, Plaintiff/Counterdefendant-Appellant, v. Louise M. FORTSON and Richard A. Fortson, Individually and as Conservator for Justin Fortson, Defendants/Counterplaintiffs-Appellees.
text: On order of the Chief Justice, the motion of defendants/counterplaintiffs-appellees to extend the time for filing their brief on appeal is GRANTED. The brief will be accepted as timely filed if submitted on or before September 11, 2019.
